answers.system_description: Software running on Raspberry Pi Zero W for a small form factor streaming speaker targeting kids and young adults

person_details.child: Uses the speaker to play back audio from their smart devices (iPad, iPhone, etc.)
person_details.parent: Plays back audio on the speaker when the child does not have their own device. Sends text messages to the device for TTS announcements.

external_system_details.spotify: Streams audio playback through the Spotify service
external_system_details.airplay: Streams audio from any app on an Apple device (iPad, iPhone, etc.)
external_system_details.home assistant: Smart home automation integration, enabling automation ideas (e.g., scheduled playback, event-triggered announcements)
external_system_details.iqaudio pi-codec zero: Hardware audio HAT providing DAC, ADC, speaker amplifier, headphone output (WM8731 codec)

relationships.label: Controls playback and selects audio source
Controls playback, selects source, sends custom TTS messages
relationships.technology: Spotify Connect, AirPlay, HTTPS (web UI), TBD (for TTS)

relationships.label: Control speaker functions, auto-discovered on local network
relationships.technology: TBD (API with auth, local network only, auto-discovery)

system_requirements: Auto-source-select: when a new source starts, previous source stops playback
Fade to mute on source switch (short fade out)
Fade from mute to previous volume when new source starts playback
Local-network API for external control (Home Assistant, etc.)
API must be authenticated, local network only

web-interface.description: Browser-based control panel with Player (playback, track skip, volume, sleep timer) and Config (radio/podcast sources, alarm, API tokens) sections. Also handles Wi-Fi setup, TTS, OTA, system info. SSR with client hydration.
web-interface.auth: handled by API Server; UI stores token
web-interface.offline: Connecting overlay with auto-retry; controls disabled; SSR content visible

api-server.description: Single Axum binary serving REST + WebSocket API and Leptos frontend. Token auth. mDNS/SSDP auto-discovery. Exposes playback, sources, config, BT pairing, CamillaDSP config, TTS, OTA, system info. Does NOT expose network config or ALSA mixer.

audio-player.description: Core audio playback engine managing audio sources, source switching with CamillaDSP fades, TTS priority ducking, sleep timer. Pipeline: source -> ALSA loopback -> CamillaDSP -> HAT.
audio-player.airplay: TBD: rairplay (Rust, early) vs shairport-sync (C, mature)
audio-player.radio_podcasts: TBD: MPD (C, proven by Volumio) vs custom Rust (rodio+stream-download) vs GStreamer
audio-player.tts_behavior: duck current source, play TTS, restore volume

bluetooth-service.description: AVRCP remote control from paired BT keypad/knob. Optional A2DP audio input under evaluation.
bluetooth-service.a2dp_decision: pending: recommend AVRCP-only for v1, add A2DP later as feature toggle
a2dp_concerns: SBC-only on Pi Zero W (no AAC/aptX/LDAC)

camilladsp.description: Software DSP engine. Master volume, EQ profiles, DSP pipeline. Two-channel ALSA loopback mixer for TTS ducking. Predefined profiles + user-uploaded configs. TCP socket (localhost only) controlled by API Server. Source routing at ALSA level, not via config reload.
camilladsp.source_routing: ALSA level: one source per loopback ch, no CamillaDSP config reload on switch
camilladsp.tts_pipeline: two loopback channels (ch0=main, ch1=TTS), CamillaDSP mixer with per-input volume

tts-engine.description: Offline TTS using Piper neural synthesis. Writes to dedicated ALSA loopback channel. FIFO queue for messages. Multi-language (EN primary). Fully offline.
tts-engine.rust_wrapper: piper-tts-rs v0.1.4 (early-stage, fallback: piper CLI subprocess)
tts-engine.languages: EN primary, others if Piper models available; EN-only fallback for v1
tts-engine.queue: FIFO, max ~10 messages, reject when full
tts-engine.audio_output: direct ALSA PCM to dedicated loopback channel
open_questions: Per-source ALSA channels: should each source get its own loopback channel?
CamillaDSP mixer per-input volume API support
ALSA loopback channel limits on Pi Zero W

ota-updater.description: Atomic full-system OTA updates via NixOS generations. GitHub Releases as update source. Auto-rollback on boot failure. Scheduled reboots in low-activity windows. User data on persistent partition.
ota-updater.rollback: built-in NixOS: auto on boot fail, manual via API
open_questions: NixOS on Pi Zero W validation (ARMv6)
Release signing strategy (GPG vs minisign vs Nix trust)
nixos-rpi-zero-w project is from 2022, needs revalidation

hat-audio-driver.description: Kernel driver for IQaudIO Pi-Codec Zero (WM8731 codec). Configured declaratively via NixOS flake (device tree overlay, kernel modules, ALSA loopback). Mixer state initialised by systemd, then CamillaDSP takes over.
